name: Miyota (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Miyota town emblem in white: a ring crossed by a horizontal bar with a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Miyota, a town in Nagano Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Miyota town emblem — a ring crossed by a horizontal bar with a stylised character
